title: Revoke outstanding sender-control authorities at SCHC terminal transition
description: Security review of the manager-issued raw SCHC egress fix found that _finish_unlocked drops outstanding data-fragment authorities but not previously issued sender ACK-REQ/control authorities. A timeout/repair ACK request issued just before a complete ACK, abort, cancel, policy invalidation, or expiry can therefore remain target-bound but signable for up to 60 seconds after its sender session is terminal. Bind sender-originated control authorities to the exact FragmentSender, revoke them on every terminal transition, preserve only a newly issued terminal Sender-Abort, and add a stale-control-after-success regression.
